decks.notes: The focus of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain control of the board with counterspells and removal while quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to apply pressure and win the game in a fast pace. The deck utilizes a low curve and efficient spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily building up its own board presence. By balancing aggression with control elements, this deck aims to win through a combination of tempo advantage and efficient creature beatdown.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing 4/5 color cards, it provides a versatile and adaptable array of threats and answers. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds consistency and allows for explosive plays. The deck's strategy revolves around early aggression with cards like Wild Nacatl and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, supported by powerful cards like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt. Stubborn Denial and Leyline Binding help protect and maintain board control, while Scion of Draco and Nishoba Brawler provide late-game powerhouses.

The deck focuses on controlling the game using disruption spells like Force of Negation and Grief while cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Striped Riverwinder to fill the graveyard. The main goal is to cast Living End or Violent Outburst to put all creatures from the graveyard onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a board full of creatures. The deck also includes cards like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves to provide additional card advantage and threats. The strategy revolves around setting up the perfect opportunity to cascade into Living End and swing the game in your favor.

This deck aims to use various cycling creatures and spells to quickly fill up the graveyard, then cast Living End to bring back a large number of powerful creatures from the graveyard all at once. The key strategy is to disrupt your opponent's board development while building up your own resources in order to overwhelm them with a sudden and powerful army of creatures. The deck focuses on setting up the combo efficiently and consistently, making it a challenging and unpredictable opponent in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck revolves around cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to fill the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring all the cycled creatures back onto the battlefield. By using cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck can easily cascade into Living End and quickly overwhelm opponents with a board full of powerful creatures. The deck also includes disruption with Force of Negation and Grief to control the game while setting up the combo. Additionally, the deck includes creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves to provide additional value and threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Hardened Scales, Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp, and The Ozolith to maximize the number of +1/+1 counters placed on creatures. With cards like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista, the goal is to quickly build up a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of powerful creatures. The deck also utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga to search for key cards and generate additional value. By taking advantage of synergies between cards, this deck aims to quickly close out games through aggressive plays and efficient creatures.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy through the use of versatile removal spells, planeswalkers, and powerful creatures. By utilizing a mix of removal, counter spells, and powerful threats, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and gradually outvalue the opponent. The deck also utilizes powerful synergies between its cards, such as using Wrenn and Six to recur lands and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate card advantage. With a mix of control elements and potent threats, this deck aims to grind out victories in a variety of matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Puresteel Paladin, Colossus Hammer, and Sigarda's Aid to create a lethal threat. This deck focuses on equipping Colossus Hammer for a massive boost in power and speed, supported by Stoneforge Mystic, Steelshaper's Gift, and Urza's Saga to search for key pieces. Protection is provided by Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce, while disruptive elements like Esper Sentinel and Surge of Salvation help control the game. Inkmoth Nexus and Kaldra Compleat provide alternative win conditions for the deck.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient spells and quick creatures to apply pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan. It aims to control the board through counterspells and removal while also developing a strong board presence with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck is built for fast-paced games and looks to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize. By combining tempo plays and aggressive threats, this UR Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on creating powerful combos using Underworld Breach to cast spells from the graveyard, utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate advantage. It aims to control the board with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler while also disrupting opponents with cards like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt. The deck also has access to Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion for additional value. By consistently recurring cards from the graveyard and applying pressure with efficient creatures, the deck aims to outpace and overwhelm opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize low-cost spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By combining efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain board presence. The inclusion of cheap cantrips such as Manamorphose and Mishra's Bauble helps to ensure consistent draws and enable powerful plays. The deck's focus on speed and aggression allows it to overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to establish their game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifact creatures and artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of threats and efficiently equip them with Cranial Plating. The key strategy involves playing low-cost artifacts and creatures to enable Metalcraft and reduce the cost of powerful cards like Thought Monitor. The deck also includes utility artifacts and lands like Urza's Saga and Mistvault Bridge to provide additional value and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to curve out quickly and apply pressure to the opponent while maintaining card advantage and resiliency.

This deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost spells to trigger Cascade effects, allowing you to cast powerful spells for free. By utilizing cards like Dead / Gone and Violent Outburst to set off Cascade, you can overwhelm your opponent with threats like Murktide Regent and Crashing Footfalls. The deck also includes control elements like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to protect your board state. With a mix of aggression and control, this deck aims to quickly build a dominating position on the battlefield before your opponent can react effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing various rituals and spells to generate mana quickly and cast Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive damage to the opponent without needing any lands in play. The deck also includes cards like Recross the Paths and Turntimber Symbiosis to search for specific cards, while Pact of Negation provides protection against opposing spells. The deck aims to combo off quickly and efficiently, using a mix of powerful spells and utility lands like Shatterskull Smashing to control the game and secure a win.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, backed up by disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck also utilizes graveyard interactions with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Seasoned Pyromancer, while maintaining card advantage through spells like Feign Death and Undying Malice. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Takenuma, Abandoned Mire provide additional versatility and potential for powerful plays. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed, disruption, and synergy.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic to cast powerful spells for free, while also maintaining a strong aggressive strategy. By combining Cascade cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst with cards like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with threats while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal. The inclusion of Fiery Islet and Gemstone Caverns helps to ensure the deck can consistently cast its spells on curve. Overall, the deck is built to be fast and disruptive, aiming to close out games quickly.
